component.name: Cloudflare WARP GUI
component.summary: Control the Cloudflare WARP client from your desktop

description.p: warp-gui is an unofficial, independent graphical front-end for the Cloudflare WARP command-line client (warp-cli) on Linux. It provides a window and a system-tray icon so you can use WARP without a terminal.

ul.li: One-click connect and disconnect with a live status indicator
Choose the operating mode, tunnel protocol and DNS family filter
Verify that traffic really goes through WARP

description.p: warp-gui is not affiliated with or endorsed by Cloudflare, Inc. and does not bundle any Cloudflare software; it requires the official WARP client to be installed separately.
